gateDefinitions.STORY_APPROVED: Operator/editorial approval binds the exact canonical episode and localized script revisions.
gateDefinitions.STORY_SCRIPT_READY: Composite readiness requires active STORY_APPROVED plus successful continuity, boundary and locale-parity admission for the same revisions.
gateDefinitions.AUDIO_TTS_READY: Exact script, locale, voice, provider configuration, budget and trust evidence may enter the bounded audio canary.
gateDefinitions.SELECTED_AUDIO_APPROVED: Selected locale audio and alignment are revision-bound final timing authority.
gateDefinitions.VISUAL_RENDER_READY: Exact visual, timeline, rights, safe-zone and render inputs passed visual/render admission.
gateDefinitions.SHARED_VISUALS_APPROVED: The EN canary visual semantics/assets are approved for locale reuse.
gateDefinitions.PUBLICATION_READY: Exact render and publication projection passed provider-neutral publication admission.
gateDefinitions.ASSET_GENERATION_APPROVED: Operator approval binds the exact paid generation scope.
gateDefinitions.COST_BUDGET_APPROVED: A revision-bound provider/episode/locale cost reservation is active.
gateDefinitions.PUBLICATION_APPROVED: Operator approval binds one exact provider post intent.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_APP_AUDIT_READY: Active provider-evidenced app/product/scope/audit revision permits the requested operation.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_OAUTH_CREATOR_INFO_READY: A bounded read-only canary verified exact account, token refresh, scopes and current creator capabilities.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_EXACT_POST_CONSENT: Active creator consent and export approval bind every exact post field required by ADR-MICRODRAMA-005.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_PRIVATE_POSTING_ENABLED: A separately authorized private capability flag is active.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_PUBLIC_POSTING_ENABLED: TikTok audit/policy evidence and operator policy explicitly enable public posting.
gateDefinitions.TIKTOK_PUBLIC_VIDEO_READ_READY: An authorized public video and official read scope are available; unsupported metrics remain unavailable.

tasks.title: Implement publication readiness admission
tasks.goal: Evaluate exact provider post intents independently after render readiness.
scope: PUBLICATION_READY projection over render, target, metadata, app/account capability, consent/export, schedule, budget and trust evidence
Provider-specific failure reasons without dispatch
acceptanceCriteria: Exact provider/account/render/metadata/privacy/interactions/declarations/consent/export/schedule identities are required
A ready projection is evidence only and never authorizes or dispatches a provider effect
validation: Run focused publication-readiness mismatch, revocation and stale-capability tests with fakes
tasks.rollback: Disable readiness projection writes; keep publication capabilities off.

tasks.title: Implement TikTok app and audit readiness evidence
tasks.goal: Represent TikTok developer-app configuration, consent/export UX and audit readiness without claiming provider approval locally.
scope: Developer app/product, Login Kit, callback/config hash, required/granted scopes and Content Posting configuration evidence
Creator-info/export UX and explicit consent/export evidence capture
Audit submission/result, environment, effective/expiry/revocation and public-posting capability state
acceptanceCriteria: A reviewed runbook/evidence contract covers developer app/product configuration, Login Kit, scopes, Content Posting, creator-info/export UX, consent UX and audit submission
Readiness is immutable/versioned and references opaque app credential handles only
Missing, expired or revoked app/product/scope/audit evidence blocks live OAuth, creator preflight and Direct Post in fixtures
Local configuration/tests cannot fabricate provider audit approval or public-posting capability
validation: Run focused app-readiness, consent/export UX and audit-evidence fixture tests
tasks.rollback: Disable app-readiness projection writers and all TikTok live capabilities.

tasks.title: Run read-only TikTok OAuth and creator-info canary
tasks.goal: Validate exact TikTok account identity, token refresh, scopes and creator capabilities before any publication mutation.
scope: One separately authorized exact app/account OAuth flow and secure credential verification
Official token refresh and creator-info/capability reads only
No upload init, transfer, Direct Post, schedule mutation, content mutation or publication
externalPrerequisites: Provider app/product configuration and approved scopes are active
The exact creator authorizes the bounded OAuth/read canary
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence records the exact authenticated account, app-readiness revision, credential version, scopes, refresh result and creator capabilities
Mismatch, expiry or revocation creates no publication intent/effect
Only declared OAuth/read endpoints are used and zero publication/content mutations occur
validation: Run one bounded OAuth/refresh/creator-info evidence audit after explicit authorization
tasks.rollback: Disable TikTok capability and revoke/disable the tested credential through the secure secret-store path.
